definitionName: Dependency and supply-chain currency (F-11, programme group 9)
note: LOCAL ONLY. This record carries the machine-checkable half of the dependency assessment: the declared engines.node range separated from the qualified points, the EOL Vue fixture's review date and interval with its mechanized review conditions, the disposable npm ci --offline lockfile verification, and the recorded negative probes. It never records an online advisory result: the dependency-advisory lane stays UNAVAILABLE_CAPABILITY until one bounded registry query is authorized. bin/project-state-check.mjs evaluates this record through src/core/dependencyCurrency/index.ts and reports the result as release condition 8; an unqualified runtime, an elapsed review, a stale lockfile date, lockfile drift or any clean-result claim made while the lane is unavailable fails that condition.

conditions: the Ripple product moves off Vue 2
the fixture begins compiling a template from non-fixture input
an advisory is published whose reachable path does not depend on template compilation
the fixture's single call site grows a second consumer
mechanizedConditions: call-site count: exactly one tracked source reaches the fixture through the declared specifier
literal-only template content: every Vue template/compile input is a string literal
require.resolve declared-dependency resolvability: every require.resolve specifier is a declared, on-disk-resolvable dependency

lockfileVerification.command: npm ci --offline --no-audit --no-fund in a disposable directory containing only package.json and package-lock.json (npm cache only; no network)
lockfileVerification.result: PASS — added 7 packages; package-lock.json byte-identical before and after (sha256 compared); one expected warning: vue@2.6.12 END OF LIFE

probes.description: add a second tracked source that reaches the fixture through the declared specifier
pass a variable to the Vue template option instead of a literal
remove vue from the declared dependencies while the fixture still resolves it
insert a clean advisory-scan claim in a governed document while the lane is UNAVAILABLE
advance the clock beyond lockfileVerification.date + intervalDays
observe Node 21 on the qualified OS
advance the clock beyond vueReview.reviewDate + reviewIntervalDays
change package-lock.json after the recorded verification digest
